poses.caption: Raise one arm overhead and bend its elbow so the hand rests behind your head. Gently guide the elbow with your other hand, keeping ribs down; hold 20–30 seconds and switch arms.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1492 TRICEPS DIP STRETCH. ONE STATIC HOLD exactly ONE full body person standing tall SIDE REAR three-quarter view facing RIGHT. Feet hip-width soles flat knees soft pelvis/ribs stacked neutral spine no back arch. Raise RIGHT upper arm OVERHEAD next to ear, RIGHT elbow BENT so RIGHT forearm folds DOWN behind head with right hand resting between shoulder blades. LEFT hand reaches OVER TOP of head to gently cup RIGHT elbow and guide it back/down. Clear realistic TWO arms and TWO hands: working right elbow highest point, working right hand behind upper back, assisting left fingers on outside right elbow. Shoulders relaxed head neutral neck long no neck pressure. Primary exposed RIGHT posterior upper-arm TRICEPS RED ONLY, left triceps and deltoids/chest forearms grayscale. Fine detailed grayscale exposed anatomical muscle contours realistic hand fingers limb proportions. Full opaque BLACK athletic tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK covers torso and black MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH seams broad folds continuous hems no cutaways/transparency/fibers through fabric. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft floor contact shadows generous12percent margins overhead elbow fingers full head both feet entirely within SQUARE no crop. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup/chest red. No text labels captions arrows extra panels.
